name: Protagonist
source:
The protagonist of this story.

He was admitted as a case of "Fairytale Syndrome," but he doesn't remember anything, nor does he know his name, or even the role he'd swamped himself in.
As he befriends the girls of Paradise, he becomes entangled in various mysteries, tragedies, and adventures.

[translated from [url=https://www.liar.co.jp/fairy/index.html]official website[/url]]
